title: Forest Hills happy days with Joe and Sally Venuti
summary: The Forest Hills house had Sunday jam sessions with Teddy Wilson, Benny Goodman and Joe Venuti; they lived with Joe and Sally Venuti when they first came to New York.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: We used to laugh so much out in Forest Hills there, gosh Johnny Mercer and Ginger would come over, people'd come by -- she used to call Teddy Theodosi's. Yeah, Theodosius is coming by.
Well she was -- she was --

Those were kind of happy days. There was no jazz in New York in those early days. Forest Hills was really a -- a Sunday afternoon was really the hub of all good playing, Teddy used to come and Benny and Joe Venuti, oh --
Oh, she loved Joe, didn't she?
Yeah, loved Joe --
Well I mean, he's so so -- witty.
What -- what?
He's witty.
Oh, yeah. He's a funny man.
He's a funny man. I mean they were a
pair, weren't they? Oh yeah. Well the four of us became inseparable at times. I have some wonderful pictures --
What four?
Huh?
Joe and --
Sally.
Oh. I see. I didn't know --
Sally was one of Mildred's best friends.
Oh, yeah, that's right, yeah. Yeah.
In fact when we came to New York we lived with Joe and Sally and I think it was 145 West 55th Street, or 155 -- oh, 145 I think, West 55th Street.
Yeah.
They had an apartment there. We were married at that time, we came in the Palace and we lived with Joe and Sally.
Yeah, that must've been a ball.
Yeah.
